subject: Intro: Redwood demo + POC planning
messages:
From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@cratech.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-21T08:13:00-07:00
Subject: Intro — looking for a short demo and POC planning

Hi Ben,

We signed up to the Redwood self-serve flow last week (trial org: cratech-trial) and an SDR reached out, but I'd love to get a quick demo to see how Redwood would fit our customer-facing assistant use case before we ramp. I attached a small traffic sample (traffic_sample.csv) to give a sense of current volume.

Quick context: Cratech AI builds a conversational assistant for e-commerce merchants (order status, returns, short summaries). We are evaluating hosted vs. private deployment because of PCI scope concerns.

High-level numbers:
- Current pilot: ~150k tokens/day, avg response ~450 tokens
- Expected POC peak: ~6–8 req/s, bursty during sale windows
- Desired POC start: early September (ideally the week of Sep 5)

Can we do a 30–45m intro/demo + short ops sync next week? Our timezone is PDT. Proposed slots (local):
- Tue Aug 24, 11:00–11:45 PT
- Thu Aug 26, 09:00–09:45 PT

Let me know if those work or send a link to your calendar.

Thanks —
Sasha Nguyen
Head of Product
Cratech AI
(sasha@cratech.ai)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@cratech.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-21T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — looking for a short demo and POC planning

Hi Sasha —

Thanks for the note and the traffic sample — really helpful. Happy to jump on a demo + ops sync. A few quick clarifying questions so we tailor the session and bring the right folks: 

1) Primary use case: is it primarily live chat (low-latency responses) or asynchronous/summary workflows?
2) Concurrency & traffic shape: you mentioned 6–8 req/s peaks — can you confirm average concurrent streams during a sale (if different)? Also rough tokens-per-minute at peak?
3) Model & quality expectations: are you experimenting with open models or planning to use a commercial model? Any quantization/latency SLOs we should know about?
4) Compliance: you noted PCI scope — do you currently need a private deployment or would Hosted (with KMS + audit logs) be acceptable for the POC?
5) Access: do you want a sandbox we can pre-configure with your sample prompts so we can demo realistic latency and costs?

Proposed demo slots (my calendar): https://cal.com/ben_carter/30
If you prefer, I can tentatively hold Thu Aug 26 09:00 PT and adjust once you confirm. I'll loop in Marissa (CS lead) and Vivek (infra eng) for the technical dive.

Agenda suggestion (30–45m):
- 10m: quick product fit + architecture options (hosted/dedicated/private)
- 15m: walkthrough with your traffic sample (latency/cost/throughput)
- 10m: next steps + POC plan (timeline, success metrics)

Attachments: please include any additional sample prompts or a more detailed traffic shape if available.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@cratech.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Meyers <jake@cratech.ai>
Date: 2027-08-21T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — looking for a short demo and POC planning

Thanks Ben — answers inline and attached an initial_requirements.docx with more detail.

1) Use case: customer support deflection + automated order summaries (mostly low-latency chat but also batch summary jobs for end-of-day reports).
2) Concurrency / shape: avg concurrent streams ~25 during normal periods, peaks up to ~120 concurrent sessions during promos. Peak tokens/minute estimate: ~40k tokens/minute (based on sample).
3) Models: testing open Llama-variant and a hosted commercial model as a fallback. Latency target: p95 < 450ms for short completions (under 150 tokens), but longer summaries will be ok up to ~2s.
4) Compliance: for the initial POC hosted with audit logs + customer-managed KMS is acceptable, but we need SOC2 documentation prior to any paid contract.
5) Sandbox: yes please — pre-loading sample prompts + a small dataset would be ideal.

Timeline: we are trying to run a 4-week POC and would like it to start the week of Sep 5. Our preferred demo slots to kick off are:
- Thu Sep 2, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Mon Sep 6, 09:30–10:15 PT

We also saw higher latency in your trial sandbox (~1.2s median for a short completion) — would love to see what tuning/quantization options you recommend.

Thanks,
Sasha

Attachments:
- initial_requirements.docx (brief with endpoints and sample prompts)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@cratech.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-21T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — looking for a short demo and POC planning

Great detail — thanks Sasha. Sep 2 at 10:00 PT works for our team. I'm tentatively booking a 45m slot to allow a short ops sync after the product walkthrough. Will send a Google Meet invite once you confirm attendees.

Pre-demo checklist / asks (so we can prepare):
- Confirm attendees and roles (PM / Eng / Security).
- Share 3 representative prompts we should preload into the sandbox.
- Indicate whether you'd like us to run a quick latency/cost run with your traffic_sample.csv or just demo at sample scale.
- Any preferred models to include in the sandbox (open model name or commercial model).

We'll bring Vivek for a 10–15m technical deep-dive (autoscaling, batching, KV caching, and network placement). Marissa will run through the POC success criteria and onboarding steps (SLA/metrics/rollback).

SOC2 docs: https://redwood.example.com/soc2 — I'll also prepare an extract of audit log examples for your security team.

If you confirm Sep 2, 10:00 PT, I'll send the calendar invite and a short pre-demo form.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha@cratech.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Meyers <jake@cratech.ai>
Date: 2027-08-21T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — looking for a short demo and POC planning

Confirmed — Sep 2, 10:00–10:45 PT. Attendees from Cratech: Sasha Nguyen (PM) and Jake Meyers (Lead Engineer). We prefer Google Meet and would like the invite to include the pre-demo checklist / short form.

We'll attach the 3 sample prompts in a follow-up and let you know if we want the full traffic run ahead of the session. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Sasha
